summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), as closing bid prices exceeded $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days through August 17, 2026. The filing includes a press release announcing the compliance and a forthcoming name change to Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. with new ticker NXAT. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms or transaction structure are involved. What to watch: continued compliance with Nasdaq listing standards and completion of the name change.
